job_offers_salary_required.name: job_offers_salary_required
job_offers_salary_required.value: "job_offers"."status" = 'draft' or "job_offers"."contract_type" in ('collaboration', 'self_employed', 'occasional') or ("job_offers"."salary_min" is not null and "job_offers"."salary_period" is not null)

job_offers_salary_range.name: job_offers_salary_range
job_offers_salary_range.value: "job_offers"."salary_min" is null or ("job_offers"."salary_min" > 0 and ("job_offers"."salary_max" is null or "job_offers"."salary_max" >= "job_offers"."salary_min"))

job_offers_valid_through.name: job_offers_valid_through
job_offers_valid_through.value: "job_offers"."status" <> 'published' or ("job_offers"."published_at" is not null and "job_offers"."valid_through" is not null and "job_offers"."valid_through" <= "job_offers"."published_at" + interval '60 days')
